title: xi. The vvaye vvhyche leadeth to the firſt death.

segments.text:
THE corruption of humors wyth infinite other inconueniences deſcendinge and di••yllynge from the ſynne of
Adam by lineall ſucceſſion and hathe brought all men vnder ſubiection to the firſt death, which is the ſeperation of the ſoule from the bodye with putrefication of the bodye.
